answer: To resist Sybil attacks, an agent economy can enforce proof-of-burn registration via a velvet protocol overlay. Each agent must permanently destroy native currency into an unspendable address, generating a cryptographic plume of burn receipts anchored to the structural timber of the shared ledger. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of scarce financial capital per identity. However, this perpetual destruction model inherently prices out capital-constrained but legitimate agents.
